scale.note: Only104mm prosomalwidth directly published for SMNS65410. Other dimensions roughsameFig1A proportional estimates +/-15percent, not caliperdata. Shellmedianlength excludes longgenalposteriorpoints; bodytotalincludes telson.

anatomy: Domed horseshoe-shaped broad prosoma with narrow raised/flattened marginal rim, paired posterior genalspines, small eyes along paired ophthalmic ridges. No Euproops-style long ophthalmicspines.
Hinged compact fused thoracetron, roughly trapezoidal/subhexagonal, tapering rearward; marginal articulated spines and smallfixedpoints. Not fan of separate loose abdominal segments.
Long straight tapering telson, no sting/venomtip; preserve articulation and modest triangularsection.

Ventral chelicerae pair, four walkingpairs and a final pushingpair using conservative limulid organization; main specimen preserves2compressedprosomallimbs and musclehomologies, not every foot pristine. Smalljointedlegs under shell, no antennae, no oversizedclaws.
Simple shallow ventral opercular/bookgill covers may be inferred from limulid family organization; do not add detailed unsourced gillmicrostructure.
